records.greeting: Back in one piece? Good. The den is safe. Rest, sort your pack, and leave when you're ready.
records.name: Moss — Den Keeper
records.rumor: Bramble Market is through the forest. Keep your valuables in its depot and spare supplies in our chest.

records.greeting: Welcome to Bramble Market. Your depot is yours alone. Nothing you leave here drops when you fall out there.
records.name: Nib — Depot Keeper
records.rumor: The depot and your den chest are separate. Pack a spare weapon before chasing a lost corpse.

records.greeting: A good edge beats a brave speech. Bring bog iron and thornwood, or see what I've got for sale.
records.name: Gruk — Blacksmith
records.rumor: Two-handed weapons need both hands. Make room for your shield before swapping, and watch the level requirements.

records.greeting: A spell learned is a spell kept. I can teach you healing, fire, and a few tricks for a dangerous road.
records.name: Vexa — Spellkeeper
records.rumor: Bind learned actions to your hotbar. Automatic targeting finds a nearby enemy; manual aiming casts toward your cursor.

records.greeting: Heading out? Don't trust an empty potion pouch. Eight scrap refills your supplies.
records.name: Pip — Provisioner
records.rumor: Glowleaf helps injured travelers. If your pack fills up, extra finds stay in a ground bag—pick them up before it expires.

records.greeting: We need the nearby paths watched. Defeat five enemies and I'll pay you for the trouble. Take it at your own pace.
records.name: Rusk — Scout Captain
records.rumor: Mirewood Bog lies southeast of the forest. Beyond Frostroot, a sealed dungeon descends three floors. Investigate its wards and bring back what you find. Turn back whenever supplies run low.

records.greeting: First time outside? The market trail is just north of me. The home trail is east. The bog is farther southeast.
records.name: Tikk — Trail Guide
records.rumor: The forest is the gentler route. Take time to gather wood and fish. Look for travelers, but watch for wandering patrols.
